description: Monitor. Watch a company site and get alerts when public signals change. Pass a domain. Optional frequency: weekly, daily, 12h, or 4h, clamped to the plan. Optional signals. Optional webhook_url (https). Requires an API key. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

signals.description: Subset of: news, funding, jobs, tech_stack, pricing, status, leadership, customers, product_launches.

webhook_url.description: https URL that receives an alert when something changes.
